errors.what: Coupler and rocker do not meet at joint B: two separate joint dots at the top, with the coupler tip overshooting the rocker tip. The coupler also looks longer than 120 mm relative to the 40 mm crank and 100 mm ground.

Drawn rocker angle disagrees with the panel rocker_deg. At t=0.33 the panel says 55.3 deg but the drawn rocker is about 70 deg. At t=1.00 the panel says 80.3 deg but the drawn rocker is slightly past vertical, about 94 deg.
